model.hub: 31P donor electron + nucleus in D0; D+ storage assumed from Exp25/26
model.optimizer: ISO_CODE searches the 3000 strongest |A|>=10 kHz candidate sites; full pool is reported separately
model.limitations: KL contact model (~50% site accuracy), secular dipolar terms, no placement/fabrication error, no charge-noise or readout physics; deterministic single-site isotope substitution is a design target, not a demonstrated fabrication method.
